notes:
Account background: large regional health system analytics org. Heavy PHI footprint (clinical notes, operative reports, pathology). Primary contact: Dr. Leena Patel (Head of Clinical Informatics) + CTO Rajesh Menon. Wants a mix of VPC-hosted and on-prem for hottest PHI data.

Conversation highlights: 
- 2024-10-21 discovery call (Marisol, Avery, Dr. Patel) — confirmed scope: enterprise search across EMR export + imaging reports + referral letters. Interested in RAG for clinician-facing search, with embeddings + reranking to improve precision on short queries.
- Key quote from Dr. Patel: "We need answers, not a list of notes — reranking must surface the most clinically relevant passage and show provenance."
- Security: mandatory SSO/SAML, hardware KMS, per-request audit logs, 7+ year retention and legal hold support. Data residency: US-only.
- Scale ask: initial index ~45M documents (notes + reports), ramp to 150M over 12 months. Average doc length variable — many short encounter notes and some long consults.
- Cost sensitivity: internal threshold <= $0.03/query (including embed + search + rerank) at 200k queries/day.
- Perf target: vector retrieval median <100ms in-region; end-to-end rerank + response <350ms for clinician flows.
- Current stack: vector DB evaluation (Weaviate + Postgres-ANN prototype), OpenSearch for metadata. Considering Redwood to replace vector infra and provide deterministic serving + private deployment.

POC specifics requested: indexing pipeline (EMR -> de-id -> embed -> index), proof of KV/prefix caching for repeated context, reranking model guidelines, fallback policies when private capacity constrained.

Internal AE notes (shorthand): 
- SE to run benchmarks on sample 10M docs using 1536-dim embeddings (clinical-tuned) + bi-encoder reranker baseline.
- Ask for Dedicated pricing for 4-8 GPUs + uplift for private control plane.
- Legal sent security questionnaire 2024-11-01; awaiting Redwood SOC2 + HIPAA addendum.

Potential upsell: Optimize recommendations for quantization to reduce per-query cost; long-term Dedicated contract + extended observability retention.

indexing_requirements: Initial ingest: 45M docs (~8TB raw text). Expected growth to 150M over 12 months. Need de-id step before private embed generation for non-onprem pipeline. Prefer batch incremental indexing with real-time delta ingest for recent notes. Require document-level provenance (EMR id, encounter id, clinician, timestamp). Embedding dimensionality target: 1024-1536 depending on model; prefer option to re-embed when model upgrades. Support for approximate nearest neighbor with deterministic rerank fallback.
performance_targets: Retrieval median <100ms intra-region for vector search; full RAG response (retrieve + rerank + LLM assemble) <350ms for clinician UI. Throughput target: 200k queries/day baseline; P95 latency requirements tighter for triage use-cases. Cost target <= $0.03/query end-to-end for steady-state.
poc_plan: 30-day POC: deploy Dedicated 2-node test cluster in customer VPC, index 10M sample docs, run synthetic traffic (peak 1k qps bursts) and production-like mixes. Deliverables: latency report, cost per query estimate, failure/recovery scenarios, SSO test plan, audit-log snapshot. Success criteria: retrieval median <=120ms, rerank precision lift >=12% vs baseline, stable at 2x expected QPS.
